verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law firm, but it markets legal tech, digital workflows and a software-supported ySolutions unit for transparency-register filings, so a public API is a conceivable capability and the axis applies. No evidence documents any public API, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
